style: Reference study for art direction only. Landscape 16:9, same high three-quarter camera angle in every study. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no readable numbers or letters on jerseys or boards, no real people, no real teams or leagues.

jobs.name: hockey-l1-a
jobs.prompt: An ice hockey rink for a toy-like 3 versus 3 game, a 60 by 30 metre rink with rounded corners, boards all around and a four metre wide goal at each end, seen from a high three-quarter camera that keeps BOTH goals in frame. Six stylized chunky toy figures (capsule bodies, round heads, simple sticks, three in deep blue jerseys and three in warm orange jerseys) and one small near-black puck on the ice. Tier look, daylight toy rink: clean stylized toy diorama, saturated flat-ish materials, pale blue-white ice with simple painted markings, bright boards, soft global illumination, strong rim light, glossy plastic accents, cheerful. Variant: an open-air rink under a clear sunny sky with simple stands around it.
